t.why: It keeps channels open even to Hamas and the Taliban and has mediated talks on Gaza and Afghanistan. It hosted the 2022 World Cup.
t.rel: Small but a big gas exporter. It keeps channels open even to Hamas and the Taliban and often mediates, and from 2017 to 2021 it was cut off and blockaded by Saudi Arabia and other neighbors.
t.korea: It has supplied a large share of the liquefied natural gas Korea imports.
t.know: Foreign workers far outnumber citizens, who make up just over 10% of the population.
t.etext: One of the world's largest exporters of liquefied natural gas. Its sovereign wealth fund invests in companies and property around the world. It has also built up its airline and finance.
